notes: Checked on the re-extracted card with the RocDonald's venue. RocDonald's is in the film (Moria lists it among the in-jokes; Encyclopedia.com: 'Soon he gives up dining at RocDonald's for Cavern on the Green'), so the sign and the brontosaurus fries note are ok. Barney's ice cream truck playing the Jetsons theme is confirmed by TV Tropes and Movie Mistakes trivia as well as Tropedia. The drive-in and Tar Wars are confirmed by the Flintstones Fandom film page (opens and ends at the Bedrock Drive-In Theater). Steak, lava juice toast, ripe old age of 38, No. 2 chisel, Concretia, Rockapulco ticket and Yabba-dabba-doo all verbatim or true on Wikiquote and Wikipedia.

vibe.verdict: The film's own lines are everywhere and the food is right, but a RocDonald's sign now sits on a drive-in theatre card with a bay ticket for Tar Wars and a speaker, so the place is split in two.
missing: Cavern on the Green, the posh place Fred moves up to (Encyclopedia.com)
Fred is the greatest bowler on Earth, the Dictabird bit (the house snack that carried it is gone)
Bedrock's Most Wanted with Jay Leno
ideas: Swap the ticket's 'Now showing: Tar Wars' and 'One car of Flintstones' for RocDonald's order slip lines, such as 'Order 38' and 'Bronto fries, extra large', so the bottom box matches the RocDonald's sign
Swap the steak sliders note 'Dino gets to Barney's steak first' for 'Hey Barn, you like your steak rare?' (Fred, Wikiquote)
Swap the pretzels' lost line back in somewhere: 'Fred is the greatest bowler on Earth!' as the lava juice note (Fred, then the Dictabird, Wikiquote)
Swap 'OVER THE SPEAKER' heading for a drive-thru speaker line that fits RocDonald's, keeping 'Yabba-dabba-doo!'
